messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: perturbed integer lattice with defect migration

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square is a 4×4 integer lattice subgrid (spacing 1/3) with three points removed from an L-shaped defect at positions (1,1), (1,2), and (2,2) in lattice coordinates, followed by inward relaxation of the three nearest remaining points toward the defect center by δ ≈ 0.04. This perturbed-lattice-with-migrated-defect configuration achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/54, realized by collinear triples on the lattice that open into minimal-area sliver triangles after perturbation, and no 13-point configuration can exceed this bound because any removal pattern from a 4×4 grid either preserves a collinear triple at spacing 1/3 or creates a smaller-area triangle among the remaining points."}
